evidence.intree_statement: Class Monic {x y} (f : x ~> y) := { monic : ∀ z (g1 g2 : z ~> x), f ∘ g1 ≈ f ∘ g2 → g1 ≈ g2 }  (* left cancellation *)
Class Epic {x y} (f : x ~> y) := { epic : ∀ z (g1 g2 : y ~> z), g1 ∘ f ≈ g2 ∘ f → g1 ≈ g2 }  (* right cancellation *)

statement_record.book: In any category C, f:A→B is a monomorphism if left-cancellable (fg=fh ⇒ g=h) and an epimorphism if right-cancellable (if=jf ⇒ i=j). Notation f:A↣B for mono, f:A↠B for epi.
statement_record.intree: Class Monic {x y}(f:x~>y) := { monic : ∀ z (g1 g2 : z ~> x), f ∘ g1 ≈ f ∘ g2 → g1 ≈ g2 }; Class Epic {x y}(f:x~>y) := { epic : ∀ z (g1 g2 : y ~> z), g1 ∘ f ≈ g2 ∘ f → g1 ≈ g2 }.
